enum.name: FMU_TM_FLAGS
enum.description: These encode flags for FMU TM report.

entry.name: FMU_TM_FLAGS_POS_VALID
entry.description: 0x02 Fields lat, lon and hdg are valid.

entry.name: FMU_TM_FLAGS_ALT_GPS
entry.description: 0x08 GPS height is being fused as a primary height reference.

entry.name: FMU_TM_FLAGS_PREARM_CHECK
entry.description: 0x10 pre-arm check status. Always true when armed

enum.name: FMU_COMPONENT_STATUS
enum.description: These encode the sensors whose status is sent as part of the FMU_TM message.

enum.name: FMU_FAILSAFE_FLAGS
enum.description: These encode the failsafe flags sent as part of the FMU_TM message.

entry.name: FMU_FAILSAFE_FLAGS_ACTION
entry.description: 0x01 irreversible failsafe action activated (that interrupts mission)

entry.name: FMU_FAILSAFE_FLAGS_CRITICAL_ATTITUDE
entry.description: 0x04 failsafe on critical pitch or roll

entry.name: FMU_FAILSAFE_FLAGS_PATH
entry.description: 0x80 failsafe on path acceptance radius violation

message.name: FMU_TM
message.field: Time of applicability of position (microseconds since UNIX epoch).
Number of satellites visible. If unknown, set to UINT8_MAX.
Vehicle heading (yaw angle), 0.0..359.99 degrees. If unknown, set to: UINT16_MAX.
Altitude (MSL). Note that virtually all GPS modules provide both WGS84 and MSL.
Rate of RTCM messages being received by WiFi
Rate of RTCM messages being received by LoRa
Bitmap showing TM flags. Value of 0: not present. Value of 1: present.
Bitmap showing which onboard components are present. Value of 0: not present. Value of 1: present.
Bitmap showing which onboard components are operational. Value of 0: not present. Value of 1: present.
Bitmap specifies detected failsafe. Value of 0: not present. Value of 1: present.
Battery voltage, UINT16_MAX: Voltage not sent by autopilot
Battery current, -1: Current not sent by autopilot
Battery energy remaining, -1: Battery remaining energy not sent by autopilot
